# Proper Buzz Barbers

> Neighborhood barbershop at 3215 Gonzales St in East Austin. A two-chair East Austin barbershop where you get exactly the cut you asked for, a good conversation, and old-school hip-hop or an EPL match on in the background.

- Phone: (512) 436-0299
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: East Austin, Govalle, Holly, East Cesar Chavez, Mueller, Downtown Austin
- Google rating: 5.0 from 84 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/proper-buzz-barbers/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/proper-buzz-barbers/book.html

## Services
- Haircuts: Short to medium men's cuts, done exactly the way you asked. Tell us what you want and that's what you walk out with.
- Fades & tapers: Skin fades, low tapers and sharp side parts, blended clean and finished with detail you'll notice in the mirror.
- Beard trims: Beard shaping and trims to go with the cut, from a tidy short beard to a full one cleaned up and squared away.

## About
Proper Buzz Barbers is a two-chair barbershop at 3215 Gonzales St in East Austin. Look for the gold-and-black PROPER BUZZ BARBERS lettering in the window. Inside, it feels more like hanging out in a friend's living room than sitting in a waiting room: black leather chairs, old-school hip-hop on the speakers, and English Premier League matches on the screen when they're playing. The barbers, Derrick and Geoffrey, are classically trained and do old school meets modern: short and medium cuts, fades, tapers and beard work for every hair texture. Some regulars have been in Derrick's chair since 2016, and they keep coming back for the same reasons: he listens, he sweats the details, and you get the cut you actually asked for.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Booking ahead is the way to go. It's a two-chair shop, and appointments keep the wait short. Book online or call (512) 436-0299 and we'll tell you what's open.
- Q: What kinds of cuts do you do?
  A: Classic short-to-medium men's cuts: skin fades, tapers, side parts, textured crops and beard trims, on every hair texture.
- Q: Who are the barbers?
  A: Derrick and Geoffrey. Plenty of clients have been with Derrick for years, some since 2016, and reviewers say Geoffrey is an awesome dude and excellent at what he does.
- Q: Can I get in on short notice?
  A: Call (512) 436-0299 and ask. Regulars say Derrick communicates great when they need an urgent cut, and we'll fit you in when we can.
- Q: Where are you, and is parking easy?
  A: 3215 Gonzales St #1101, Austin, TX 78702, in East Austin. Parking is easy.
- Q: How can I pay?
  A: Credit cards and mobile payments are accepted.
